fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 1: Norwalk Hospital, under the leadership of Christopher Stenberg, MBChB, FAAP, Vice President of Medical Education at Nuvance Health, strives to provide contemporary and comprehensive medical education and training that will enhance the health and wellbeing of their patients, communities, providers, and staff.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 2: Norwalk Hospital provides oversight and support for accredited graduate medical education, undergraduate medical education, community health education, and allied health programs. Norwalk Hospital also provides support and coordination for simulation training, library and knowledge resources services, and continuing medical education activities across their health system.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 3: Your education is their priority. They understand that there is a great deal to learn in these three years, and they want your time best spent on mastering your clinical and diagnostic skills, communicating with patients, and learning about systems-based practice. Their curriculum, faculty, resources, and diverse patient population provide an ideal environment for residency training.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 4: Broad Clinical Training: The residency provides extensive clinical training across primary care, critical care, and various subspecialties, ensuring residents develop a comprehensive set of skills essential for internal medicine.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 5: Patient Diversity: Residents gain valuable experience treating a wide variety of patients in both inpatient and outpatient settings, enhancing their ability to manage diverse medical conditions effectively.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 6: Advanced Educational Methods: The curriculum incorporates state-of-the-art simulation training, evidence-based practices, and specialized tracks tailored to modern healthcare needs, preparing residents for real-world medical challenges.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 7: Committed Faculty: The program boasts a dedicated team of faculty members who are deeply involved in mentorship, research, and education, offering robust support and guidance to residents throughout their training.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 8: Research Opportunities: Residents are encouraged to participate in clinical research projects, present their findings at national conferences, and publish their work, fostering a strong academic environment and contributing to medical advancements.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 9: Community-Academic Integration: The program uniquely blends community-based practice with the academic rigor of Yale University, providing a holistic and enriched training experience that combines practical patient care with cutting-edge research.

fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 2: The program promotes intellectual, emotional, and physical growth with the support of their peers and mentors. fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 1: In addition to new Critical Care and Emergency Departments, construction was completed in 2006 on a new Department of Medicine Education Center, including a new medical library, on–call suite, resident study, and meeting rooms. In 2012, a new state–of–the–art auditorium will be completed as part of Unity Hospital's largest ever expansion/modernization project, slated to be completed in 2014. This expansion will enhance the medical education of our residents by providing them with the most up–to–date clinical technology and training resources within a centralized teaching facility.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 2: Excellence in medical education, combined with an emphasis on compassion, has always been the centerpiece of their training first at St. Marys Hospital and now through Unity Health Systems Internal Medicine Residency Program at Unity Hospital. For well over 70 years, they have helped shape thousands of dedicated medical professionals who serve the local community and communities around the world. In the last five years alone, the graduates have gone on fellowships at major academic medical centers in such fields as Cardiology, Infectious Disease, Gastroenterology, Hematology/Oncology, Pulmonology, Critical Care, and Endocrinology. Our teaching faculty continues to grow, with recent additions in cardiology, neurology, pulmonary and critical care, and endocrinology. Our facilities and services are growing right along with our reputation. In addition to new Critical Care and Emergency Departments, construction was completed in 2006 on a new Department of Medicine Education Center, including a new medical library, on–call suite, resident study, and meeting rooms. In 2012, a new state–of–the–art auditorium was completed as part of Unity Hospital's largest ever expansion/modernization project, slated to be completed in 2014. This expansion will enhance the medical education of their residents by providing them with the most up–to–date clinical technology and training resources within a centralized teaching facility.
